Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H743-745)

committees.name: Banking, Housing, and Urban Affairs Committee

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects certain banking entities and small business investment companies seeking capital investments.
dimensions.evidence: authorizes certain banking entities to invest up to 15% of their capital and surplus in one or more small business investment companies

dimensions.assessment: Expands allowable investment ceilings from 5 percent to 15 percent, potentially altering capital allocation strategies for qualifying institutions.
dimensions.evidence: by striking "5 percent" and inserting "15 percent"

dimensions.assessment: Increases the potential volume of private capital investments into small business investment companies up to 15% of capital and surplus, though exact aggregate monetary impact is unstated.
dimensions.evidence: authorize certain banking entities to invest up to 15% of their capital and surplus

dimensions.assessment: Amends a single section of the Small Business Investment Act of 1958.
dimensions.evidence: Section 302(b) of the Small Business Investment Act of 1958 (15 U.S.C. 682(b)) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Provides a permanent statutory change to banking investment limits.

missing_information: Total expected dollar increase in capital flow or number of banking entities expected to utilize the higher investment limit.
importance_detail.rationale: This bill triples the investment cap for certain banking entities in small business investment companies, creating moderate financial opportunities for regional capital flows.
